pagination.completeExpression: ={{ (() => { if (typeof $response.body.has_more !== 'boolean') throw Error('Invalid Stripe page'); if ($response.body.has_more && (!Array.isArray($response.body.data) || !$response.body.data.length || (typeof $response.body.data.at(-1).id !== 'string' || !$response.body.data.at(-1).id))) throw Error('Missing Stripe cursor'); if ($pageCount >= 100 && $response.body.has_more) throw Error('Stripe pagination exceeded 100 pages'); return !$response.body.has_more; })() }}

parameters.jsCode: const out=[];for(const p of $input.all()){const body=p.json.body;if(!body||!Array.isArray(body.data))throw Error('Invalid Stripe page');for(const c of body.data){if(!c||!['succeeded','pending','failed'].includes(c.status)||typeof c.id!=='string')throw Error('Invalid Stripe charge');if(c.status!=='succeeded')continue;if(typeof c.customer!=='string'||!c.customer||!Number.isSafeInteger(c.amount)||typeof c.currency!=='string'||!(c.description===null||typeof c.description==='string'))throw Error('Invalid charge or missing customer');out.push({json:c})}}return out;

const c=$('Process charges one by one').item.json;if($json.id!==c.customer||$json.deleted===true||typeof $json.name!=='string'||!$json.name.trim())throw Error('Charge customer has no usable name or mismatched ID');return [{json:{name:$json.name}}];
